name: magnetic-field
title: Magnetic Field
description: A grid of short dashes that lean, swing or swirl as the pointer passes near, standing in for iron filings. A small switch changes the behaviour between attract, repel and orbit.
use: A page wants a physical, interactive field that reacts to the cursor without needing a click.
avoid: It requires a fine pointer, so touch shows only the still grid, and many dashes animate every frame.
a11y: The whole effect switches off for reduced-motion or coarse pointers, but the moving dashes have no text alternative. (keyboard: n-a, labels: none, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A wide rounded dark panel packed with neat rows of short horizontal dashes, mostly grey with a scattering of pink ones. A small light segmented control sits beneath it, and around the pointer the dashes bend out of their rows.
behaves: Moving the pointer over the panel pulls nearby dashes toward it, pushes them off or sends them circling, with each dash springing back to its place when the cursor goes. The switch changes the field, and the dashes tilt to follow the pointer's angle.
customise: Pass an items array of elements and ids, and tune mode, radius, strength, stiffness, damping, rotation and a paused flag; each dash is markup you supply.
weight: moderate: A requestAnimationFrame spring integrator over roughly a hundred dashes on every frame.
